author: Ben Gilbert
title: Apple's next major update to the Mac arrives this fall, and is called 'Mojave' - here are all the new features (AAPL)
text: Apple's next major update to the Mac arrives this fall, and is called 'Mojave' — here are all the new features (AAPL) By Ben Gilbert Jun 4, 2018, 4:33 pm 26 pts Apple introduced the next major update to the MacOS operating system on Monday: It's called Mojave. The new OS introduces a few major changes, the biggest of which is the ability for some iOS apps to work on MacOS — another blurring of lines between Apple's two main operating systems.
